says: bin.ts and kalfa/records/README.md say pnpm lint runs `node kalfa/records/src/bin.ts check`, but the lint script in package.json on origin/main has no such part, so the status, patch, link and map checks run in no CI job.
proof: git show origin/main:package.json | grep -n records shows only the @kalfa/records dependency, no lint part; grep -rn 'records/src/bin' across package.json, oxlint-plugins and .github finds only comments and the README.
cost: A superseded-record link or a patching decision can land with no check failing, since nothing runs the four checks.
